name: 7heaven
author: Nikku4211; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: 7heaven by Nikku4211, an action game starring a grim reaper, made for the Game Boy Competition 2023: run along the street and cut your way through the enemies. MIT license (github.com/nikku4211/7heaven).

descriptions.it: 7heaven di Nikku4211, un gioco d'azione con protagonista una mietitrice, realizzato per la Game Boy Competition 2023: corri lungo la strada e fatti largo tra i nemici a colpi di falce. Licenza MIT (github.com/nikku4211/7heaven).
